authorization.source: Explicit request to process queued SPEC-0118

comparison.assessment: Existing privacy/publication rules address disclosure, not unwarranted conversational safety check-in repetition. One targeted, scoped prohibition covers both unsolicited reflexive initiation and repeated formulaic prompts without splitting into duplicate atoms.
comparison.safety_boundary: Scope is limited to unwarranted questioning; materially new credible indications of current risk permit proportionate safety responses.

notes: No profile was edited and no queued profile ideas were processed or selected. Catalog publication does not activate rules in unrelated conversations.
